senses.gloss: c. (a Dispael of קַרְתָּא, v. דְּ־) part of a town, settlement, private town (עיר של יחיד).
units: Erub. 59ᵃ ‘a private town which became public ground’ כגון דאיס׳ וכ׳ ed. (Ms. M. דיס׳) e.g. the diskarta of the Resh Galutha.
<cite ref="Gittin 40a:13">Gitt. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>דס׳ דעבדי</he> a settlement of slaves.

<cite ref="Megillah 16a:5">Meg. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>סגי ליה בחדא ד׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בחד</he>) he is sufficiently rewarded with a township (as a royal grant, v. <cite ref="D00670"><he>דִּיסְתָּקָא</he></cite>).—
Sot. 6ᵇ רב יהודה מד׳ Rab Judah of Diskarta. [Fl. to Levy Targ. Dict. II, 577ᵃ identifies our w. with Pers. dastcharah, dascharah.]
